Mumbai Police Prohibits Photos/Videos of Durga Idol Immersion; High Court Strict on Firecrackers

Mumbai Police have prohibited the photography and videography of Durga idol immersion. Separately, the Bombay High Court has issued strict directives regarding the use of firecrackers, stating there will be a year-round ban on bursting them on roads. This directive was issued before Diwali.
